format: Silent branded hero video with no voiceover. The instrumental music is the entire audio layer and plays at full level for the whole clip.

scene.description: A modern, confident brand wordmark / motion-graphics hero. No presenter, no spoken words. Clean premium tech aesthetic.

music_direction.intent: A present, full-level instrumental bed that carries the entire video on its own. This is the only audio, so it should feel intentional and engaging, not a quiet pad hiding under speech.
music_direction.instrumentation: warm synth pads, soft electronic pulse, light arpeggiated texture, subtle low-end foundation
music_direction.energy: gentle forward motion with a mild sense of build, confident but not aggressive
music_direction.fade: gentle fade in at the start, clean fade out at the end of the clip
avoid: any reference to a specific artist or song

notes: Generic test fixture for proving the silent/no-voice music path end to end. Not a real campaign. Music plays at full level as the sole audio layer; the brief should target a foreground bed, not an under-speech bed.
